howItWorks.title: How this demo works
howItWorks.localBody: Your recovery phrase and private keys are created and stored on this device only. They are never uploaded or backed up to a server.
howItWorks.signBody: Sends are simulated and nothing is signed or broadcast. Confirming one asks for your biometrics or device passcode, or your app passcode on a device with no screen lock.
howItWorks.backendBody: The backend receives just your public address — to fetch cached prices, run address risk checks and simulate transactions. It cannot move your funds.
howItWorks.testnetBody: Nadir runs on test networks only. Live data covers Ethereum Sepolia and Polygon Amoy; the other networks show demo data. Balances and prices are estimates and hold no real-world worth.
